ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$2.41 (voucher) for the unexempted detour segment; record the RD-1 breach; flag driver account for review (2nd upheld route_deviation in 90 days).
ruling.reasoning: RydeTAXI (metered) fare: distance_fare 15.14 / distance_km 10.74 = $1.4097/km. GPS (30 s samples) diverges from the quoted polyline (AYER RAJAH EXPRESSWAY corridor) from about 12:12 into a northern loop via the 1.314–1.315/103.769–103.770 area, returning to the corridor at ~12:14: the driver drove roughly 1.7–1.9 km extra before rejoining the route. Taking the straight-line/mapped gap as the conservative measure (≈1.71 km), the rider-named-dropoff-compliant refund = 1.71 km × $1.4097 = S$2.41 (see cited_facts for the two figures and their spread; the fact tool would normally fix the segment precisely — flagged as an evidence limitation). No chat exists (chat: []), so the driver’s assertion that “the GPS rerouted” is a bare claim, not rider consent (G11); the traffic band on AYER RAJAH (band 4 ≈ 40–49 km/h) and the absence of any LTA incident do not exempt the segment under RD-4. Rider’s “app estimated 8 km vs meter 11 km” exaggeration and the full quoted-vs-actual difference (8.432 vs 10.74 km) are rejected: only the unexempted segment is refundable under RD-2, not corridor/noise kilometres. Driver profile (route_disputes_upheld_90d = 2) makes this a repeated route dispute → flag_account per RD-6.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route loop starting ~12:12 (GPS 1.3108,103.7673 → 1.3137,103.7685 → 1.3152,103.7699 → 1.3135,103.7684) is nowhere on the quoted AYER RAJAH EXPRESSWAY corridor (1.31132,103.76359 → 1.30973,103.7651). Chat is empty, so no rider message preceded the segment; the driver’s “GPS rerouted” is a claim only (RD-5, G11). No RD-4 incident on the replaced corridor (traffic-incidents empty) and band 4 does not exempt. Unexempted → refund extra_km × $1.4097/km (RD-1, RD-2).

rejected_claims.reason: Meter/track shows 10.74 km, not 11 km; and the quoted route was 8.432 km, so the rider’s comparison overstates the deviation.

No incident or congestion evidence on the replaced optimal corridor (traffic-incidents empty; AYER RAJAH band 4 only, and bands alone do not exempt under RD-4(b)); with an empty chat, the driver’s statement is a claim, not rider consent (G11/RD-5).
